run_process_entry: run the process_entry module with a data_file and init_file to execute pickled entry point functions
parse_process_entry_flags: parse command-line flags for the process_entry script and return unconsumed arguments
execute_init_function: execute an init function loaded from a pickle file before running the main entry point
load_and_run_functions: load pickled functions from a data_file and execute the first function in the list
forward_jax_flags: forward absl flags to JAX when jax_ prefixed arguments are detected on the command line
